notes: Healthy/organic supermarket chain of the Wong Seaone family (Gestión 2026-04-24); brand written 'Flora & Fauna', abbreviated 'F&F'. IDENTIFICATION on the user's slides: the black square 'F&F' logo on the Lima Sur slide = Flora y Fauna (matches this chain's official avatar). The red/pink ring with two green leaves (radish/fruit-like) on the same slide is NOT Flora y Fauna: it is Vivanda's official icon (https://www.vivanda.com.pe/ico_vivanda-180x180.png). Store count: Gestión 2026-04-24, new San Isidro store on Av. Dos de Mayo is 'el número 13 de la cadena'; a later 14th store in Magdalena was mentioned by a search snippet but could not be verified (source page returned 403). The official store page loads its list client-side (not captured). Site contact e-mail domain is produsana.com (legal entity name not verified). No Wikidata item found (searched 2026-09-30/10-01). Colours from the official avatar: near-black #232522, cream #EBE8E3. OSM (probe 2026-10-01): ~4 features ('Flora & Fauna', 'Flora y Fauna', 'Flora Y Fauna'; shop=supermarket or health_food). Regex is anchored to avoid 'Flora Tristán' schools/markets, 'Bodega Flora', 'Veterinaria Fauna Urbana', etc.
